title: FreeFormer Configuration Manifest
description: Single source of truth for all FreeFormer environment variables, secrets, and bindings

variables.name: ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Deployment mode (development / staging / production).

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error, none). Inferred from ENVIRONMENT if omitted (production=warn, staging=info, development=debug).

variables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g. https://example.com,https://staging.example.com).

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable/disable IP rate limiting (true / false).

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS
variables.description: Max requests allowed per rate limit window per IP.

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW
variables.description: Duration of rate limit window in seconds.

variables.name: STORAGE_ENGINE
variables.description: Primary storage engine for form submissions (kv, d1, none).

variables.name: EMAIL_PROVIDER
variables.description: Outbound email provider (none, console, mailtrap, resend, sendgrid, mailgun).

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM

requiredIf.condition: Required when EMAIL_PROVIDER is not 'none' or 'console'

variables.description: Outbound 'From' email address (e.g. contact@yourdomain.com).

variables.name: EMAIL_TO
variables.description: Target notification recipient email address (e.g. alerts@yourdomain.com).

variables.name: EMAIL_API_KEY
variables.description: API key for Mailtrap, Resend, SendGrid, or Mailgun.

variables.name: EMAIL_API_KEY_${SITE_ID}
variables.description: Per-site email provider API key override (e.g. EMAIL_API_KEY_BRAINENDEAVOR).

variables.name: EMAIL_TO_${SITE_ID}
variables.description: Per-site notification recipient email override (e.g. EMAIL_TO_BRAINENDEAVOR).

variables.name: EMAIL_FROM_${SITE_ID}
variables.description: Per-site 'From' email sender override (e.g. EMAIL_FROM_BRAINENDEAVOR).

variables.name: EMAIL_PROVIDER_${SITE_ID}
variables.description: Per-site email provider override (e.g. EMAIL_PROVIDER_BRAINENDEAVOR).

variables.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Global default Cloudflare Turnstile secret key.

variables.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY_${SITE_ID}
variables.description: Per-site Turnstile secret key (e.g. TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY_MYSITE).

variables.name: API_KEY

requiredIf.condition: Required for admin GET endpoints (/submissions) or /email-test; optional for public submissions which only require a Turnstile token

variables.description: Bearer API token for admin GET endpoints (/submissions, /submission/:id, /email-test) and webhook signing. Public form submissions only require a Turnstile token.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Global fallback webhook POST URL triggered on submission events.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_URL_${SITE_ID}
variables.description: Per-site webhook POST URL (e.g. WEBHOOK_URL_MYSITE).

variables.name: MAILGUN_DOMAIN
variables.description: Mailgun sending domain (required when using Mailgun).

variables.name: MAILTRAP_INBOX_ID
variables.description: Mailtrap inbox identifier for sandbox testing mode.
